rebuild: pnpm assets:game (Blender 5.2, assets/prepare-game-models.py): base colour only, textures downsized, swarm enemies decimated to ~900 tris. Tree and bush sources come from blender --background --factory-startup --python assets/props/build-props.py (closed icosphere clumps, vertex colours) because their Tripo exports were open shard shells; Squirtle, Pikachu, Wartortle and Raichu (and Charmander, via pnpm assets:charmander) take their run from blender --background --factory-startup --python assets/characters/run-bipeds.py (two-bone leg IK on the Tripo biped rig, heel peel, longer stride with a flight phase) because Tripo's in-place runs were too short-strided for the forms' speeds under the cadence cap; the Bulbasaur line (Bulbasaur, Ivysaur, Venusaur) comes from blender --background --factory-startup --python assets/characters/rig-quadrupeds.py (hand-built armature, region weights, scripted diagonal trot) because the Tripo quadruped rigs misread the bodies; Wartortle's and Blastoise's violet bellies (from Tripo's own reference images, so a re-texture would repeat them) are repainted cream by hue band (recolour); every Tripo biped but Charmander (re-posed by its own prepare-model.mjs) has its shoulder and upper-arm keys turned half-way back to the T-pose (open_arms), because Tripo's retargeted idle and run lower the arms like a slim human's and bury the hands in these round bellies; run-bipeds.py moves tail vertices Tripo skinned to an arm or foot onto the pelvis (rehome); the multiview forms (2026-11-06) get symmetrise(run_shift) before open_arms: it mirrors the better-fitting side's rest bones, skin weights and clip keys onto the other side, because Tripo's preset idle leans to one side and its rigger fits the two arms differently
